# IDI — Institute of Design & Innovation

> IDI pioneers Decision Intelligence Design (DID) in Africa: research, strategy, and implementation that transform how services are designed and delivered. We turn complex public and social challenges into systems, tools, and capability that work in real contexts.

Based in Nairobi, Kenya. Working across {{ countries|default:"14" }} African countries.

## What We Do

Three integrated service pillars:

- **Insights & Data (Diagnostic → Synthesis)**: We uncover what is true, what matters, and what works — evidence, diagnostics, and research synthesis.
- **Strategy & Design (Systems → Blueprint)**: We design systems, services, and pathways that enable meaningful progress.
- **Implementation & Scale (Enablement → Toolkit)**: We turn strategy into action, adoption, and long-term capability.

## Where We Apply It

- Governance & Public Service Delivery
- Responsible / Sovereign AI
- Sustainability Practice
- Venture Building & Innovation Ecosystems
- Community & Public Service Delivery
- Food Systems & Health Practice

## DIDAcademy

Capability-building programs in Decision Intelligence Design for senior leaders (Executive), practitioners and young professionals (Emerging Talent), and ecosystem partners.

## Track Record

120+ projects delivered, 35+ institutional partners, 8 focus practices, 98.4% placement rate for strategic implementations.
